2.en: When the Noctis Aeterna receded from most of the sector, Inquisitor Lord Hieronymo Drake, the Inquisition’s highest representative in the Macharian Sector, was discovered dead. Details surrounding his death remain a mystery, but as Inquisitor Lord of the sector, Drake was the only Inquisitor the others trusted or at least respected. Currently, no one has taken his place.

10.en: of the @UUID[.AyQTdRJpdVm3zqdF#ordo-hereticus]{Ordo Hereticus} was Lord Hironymo Drake’s former Interrogator. She learned long after the fact of her master’s demise, far from his side during the Noctis Aeterna. She’s since re-secured many of Drake’s assets and rebuilt what she could of his network. Horst now calls upon the Inquisitors of the Macharian Sector to gather in Conclave to regroup and co-ordinate the Inquisition’s missions — but Horst also suspects foul play on the death of Lord Drake, believing the other Inquisitors of the sector are withholding information.

18.en: of the @UUID[.AyQTdRJpdVm3zqdF#ordo-xenos]{Ordo Xenos} holds an exacting hatred of his alien enemies. His agents have evidence of increased Genestealer Cult activity at an alarming synchronicity across the sector. Serranus theorises that the Noctis Aeterna was the perfect cover the cults needed to accelerate their activities and infiltrate facets of the Macharian Adeptus Terra. He can see that the infestation is more advanced than anyone realises.

26.en: is a member of the @UUID[.AyQTdRJpdVm3zqdF#ordo-hereticus]{Ordo Hereticus}. Yet some suspect she serves a more obscure Holy Order, the @UUID[.AyQTdRJpdVm3zqdF#ordo-malleus]{Ordo Malleus}, whose mission combats daemons and monsters of the Warp. But speaking aloud of this Ordo and their enemy is a crime in and of itself. Daemonic activity can spawn wherever heresy plagues, so Raud has the most widespread and well-informed network of spies and operatives of her peers — who she also undoubtedly surveils.

34.en: of the @UUID[.AyQTdRJpdVm3zqdF#ordo-hereticus]{Ordo Hereticus} believes a significant threat lies within the noble families who defied the Lord Solar Macharius during the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#the-macharian-conquests]{Macharian Crusade} and fled compliance. Halikarn suspects that the remnants of these nobles, now declared Excommunicate Traitoris, are working in the shadows. They seek to regain control of their former territories, plant themselves into other positions of power, or worse, they have already succeeded, and none are the wiser. Inquisitor Halikarn was introduced in @UUID[Compendium.impmal-starter-set.journals.JournalEntry.arjSGA9gcUykxq0z]{The Blazing Seraph}, the featured adventure included in the

50.en: of the @UUID[.AyQTdRJpdVm3zqdF#ordo-xenos]{Ordo Xenos} investigates all manner of alien activity in the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96]{Macharian Sector} and is a known expert in the Aeldari. Drukhari raiders and Aeldari Corsairs, in particular, are a bane to the sector’s voidborn and the Imperial fleet, leading waves of piracy across the outer reaches of the sector, assaulting Rogue Traders, and still settling worlds. If left unchecked, they may seek to claim Imperial worlds as their own.

58.en: of the @UUID[.AyQTdRJpdVm3zqdF#ordo-hereticus]{Ordo Hereticus} works tirelessly to investigate the threats posed by psykers and psychic phenomena. The @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.OjmVcVX5lv76LsvL]{Adeptus Astra Telepathica} was stricken dearly by fallout from the Noctis Aeterna, causing many populated worlds to generate a considerable backlog of captured psykers. Until the Black Ships arrive, most worlds are ill-equipped to hunt down and contain this surplus. As a result, rogue psyker activity is on the rise. Inquisitor Baek is tackling the problem head-on, coordinating between the Astra Telepathica, their Black Ships, and Ministorum-led witch-hunts across the sector.

64.en: For GMs, the investigations and machinations of these Inquisitors continue in the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.FNEW8e33IisZh27W]{Heresies Macharia}, a campaign framework filled with unique NPCs, missions, and plot hooks to drive Inquisition-focused campaigns throughout the Macharian Sector.
